title: Economy rules
description: Global balance constants and formulas (/data/economy.json). Every tuning number that is not tied to a specific guest, song, drink, upgrade, band level, venue or event lives here, so nothing is hardcoded in client or server.

mood.description: Each seated table has a mood 0-100. The room mood meter is the average mood of occupied tables (neutral when empty). Song effect on a table = delta * genre match strength * song.mood_power * guest.mood_sensitivity * (band.mood_multiplier if positive) * song_mood_power upgrades.

neutral.description: Room mood when empty; table moods decay toward this.

song_match_delta.description: Mood change for a full genre match (partial matches scale by genre strength).

preferred_drink_delta.description: Mood change when a table is served its preferred drink.

decay_per_minute.description: Drift of table mood toward neutral per minute.

waiting_penalty_per_minute.description: Mood loss per minute once a table has waited longer than its patience.

leave_at_or_below.description: Table leaves without tipping at or below this mood.

tips.description: Bakšiš per table = bill * guest.tip_rate * mood_curve(table mood) * band.tip_multiplier * tip_rate upgrades * (1 + preferred_drink_bonus if served its preferred drink).

arrivals.description: Arrival rate = venue.arrivals_per_minute * room_mood_curve(room mood) * arrival_rate upgrades. Groups only arrive while a table is free.

roll_interval_seconds.description: How often a random-event roll happens.

condition_check_interval_seconds.description: How often condition-triggered events (e.g. tuča) are checked.

global_cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum gap between any two events.

fight_chance_min_multiplier.description: Floor for the combined fight_chance multiplier from upgrades and effects.

offline.description: Offline earnings. rate_per_minute = venue.offline_income_per_minute * menu_price upgrades * arrival_rate upgrades * offline_income upgrades * (tables / venue.base_tables) * band.tip_multiplier - band.upkeep_per_hour / 60 (floored at 0). cap_hours = min(venue.offline_cap_hours + offline_cap_hours upgrades, max_cap_hours). granted = floor(rate_per_minute * min(away_minutes, cap_hours * 60) * live-event multipliers for income and offline_income, applied pro rata to the part of the counted period each live event overlaps), or 0 if away less than min_away_seconds. Random events do not happen offline.

Curve.description: Piecewise-linear curve: points sorted by x; values between points are linearly interpolated, values outside are clamped to the end points.
